scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts && npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/api

scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts && vitest run src && npm run test --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run test --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts && npm run test --workspace @hasarbotu/api
